description: This PHP class 'LocalFile' implements file handling functionalities such as connect, upload, delete, rename, size, mtime, exists, get_contents, put_contents, and directory management operations for local files within the Goteo project. It extends a base class and implements a file interface, providing methods for remote-like file management on the local filesystem.

classes.name: LocalFile
classes.description: A class for handling local filesystem files with operations such as connect, upload, delete, rename, check existence, retrieve size, mtime, and contents. Implements remote-like file management on local disk and manages directory structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LocalFile object with a specific path and sets the base directory.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Checks if the file connection can be established; for local filesystem, checks link or realpath.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current file connection (resets link status).

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the absolute real path of the given remote or default path.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Stores a local file onto the remote (local disk), overwriting if exists, with optional directory auto-creation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a remote file, with optional directory cleanup.

methods.name: delete_empty_dir
methods.description: Deletes empty directories up the hierarchy, respecting maximum directory constraints.

methods.name: mkdir_recursive
methods.description: Creates directories recursively on the remote path.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a remote file to a local path, supporting HTTP/HTTPS streams.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a remote file, with options to auto-create directories and delete old directories.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of a remote file.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a remote file.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a remote file exists.

methods.name: get_contents
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of a remote file.

methods.name: put_contents
methods.description: Writes data to a remote file.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Generates a unique filename on remote to avoid overwriting existing files.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the remote path, ensuring the path does not start with a slash and prepends the base directory.
